title: Extract a specific architecture from a universal binary
summary: If you have a universal binary (containing code for multiple CPUs), you can extract just the version for one architecture, such as Apple Silicon (arm64) or Intel (x86_64). This creates a smaller, single-architecture file.

steps.explain: Use `lipo` with `-thin` to extract the code for a specific architecture from a universal binary and save it to a new file.

placeholders.name: BINARY_FILE
placeholders.description: Path to the universal binary file

placeholders.name: ARCHITECTURE
placeholders.description: The architecture to extract (e.g., arm64, x86_64, arm64e)

placeholders.name: OUTPUT_FILE
placeholders.description: Path where the extracted single-architecture file will be saved
